questions.question: Pick a crew and watch them work for a few minutes. What did you see, good and bad?

say_if.any: Talk it over with the crew afterward.

questions.more_info: Select a crew and spend a few minutes watching how they work.  Are they set up and performing work safely?  Are there things they need to change?  Make a few notes of what you see and pictures to illustrate what was going on?  After watching, discuss what you saw with the crew - good things, as well as those that need improvement.
